title: Finite scalar mates identify a normalized tensor comparison
statement: Fix l,E,W as in [def-trf-completion-unit-models], an ordinary model M, and a fixed coefficient derived system calculus S [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let c identify the termwise limit with roosLimitFunctor, preserving all degreewise projections, and let eta be normalized on every K-injective tower by eta followed by rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso equal to Q(c inverse). Given a natural comparison epsilon : Q S.reduction -> M.quotient Q, suppose only that for each complex Q its S-adjunction transpose equals Q of the ordinary tensor-adjunction unit followed by the explicit M.limitComparison/eta/exact-restriction composite at M.quotient(Q). Then, for every flat-term K-flat Q and every n, the derived evaluation of epsilon_Q, followed by the exact evaluation localization factor and Q(M.evaluation n), equals S.reductionEvaluation n followed by the fixed coefficientFiniteReductionModel. This theorem constructs no epsilon, adjunction or universal derived functor, and assumes neither universality nor invertibility of epsilon.

proof.text: Define two natural transformations from the ordinary tower-limit localization to localized exact evaluation. On a K-injective tower their equality is precisely eta normalization followed by coefficientConstantTowerProjection_exists. For any tower choose a quasi-isomorphism into a K-injective tower. Exact evaluation preserves that quasi-isomorphism, so naturality and cancellation of its localized image extend the equality to every tower (private helper limitUnit_projection).

The private square_factors helper computes the canonical square of exact derived functors using mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_hom_app_factors and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac. Cancel the initial invertible localization factor in this generic helper, before specializing to coefficient categories. Apply the resulting identity directly to actual sequence restriction, constant-tower evaluation, finite evaluation and scalar restriction. Naturality of the total-limit projection moves the inverse exact-restriction factor past the projection. Combine this with limitUnit_projection; hc identifies c inverse followed by the termwise projection with the actual ordinary complex-limit projection (system_projection). Degreewise, M.limitComparison_projection and M.unit_tensor identify the projected ordinary tensor unit with the chosen scalar-extension unit (ordinary_unit).

The private finiteModel_unit helper explicitly rewrites identity maps and closes the asIso_hom equality by reflexivity in the finite model comparison, and puts the existing derivedScalarExtensionRestrictionAdjunction K-flat normalization into cochain-localization coordinates, by the exact-restriction factor equation and the quotient-to-derived factor isomorphisms. Precompose the proposed finite comparison with S.reductionEvaluation inverse, apply injectivity of the finite adjunction Hom equivalence, and postcompose by the invertible scalar-restriction localization factor. S.unit_projection and naturality of coefficientSequenceProjection express its left side as hunit projected to level n. Use system_projection and ordinary_unit to identify this with the localized ordinary scalar unit. finiteModel_unit identifies the right side with the same map. No faithfulness of derived evaluation, boundedness, or nonzero condition is used.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteComparison_of_unit
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W) (M : OrdinaryModel l E W)
    (c : (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource l E W) ⥤
      scalarReductionSource l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅ roosLimitFunctor)
    (hc : ∀ (Z : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
      (n : ℕ) (p : ℤ),
      (c.hom.app Z ≫ limit.π Z.asFunctor (op n)).f p = limit.π (Z.X p) (op n))
    (η : roosLimitFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ coefficientConstantTowerLimit l E W)
    (hηnorm : ∀ (J : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
      [J.IsKInjective], η.app J ≫
        ((lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource l E W) ⥤
          scalarReductionSource l E W).rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso J).hom =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (c.inv.app J))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ S.reduction ⟶ M.quotient l E W ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (hunit : ∀ Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ,
      S.adjunction.homEquiv (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((M.quotient l E W).obj Q)) (ε.app Q) =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((M.adjunction.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app Q) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Q.map (M.limitComparison.hom.app ((M.quotient l E W).obj Q)) ≫
        η.app ((tower l E W).obj ((M.quotient l E W).obj Q)) ≫
        (coefficientConstantTowerLimit l E W).map
          ((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
            ((M.quotient l E W).obj Q)))) :
    ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
        (hQ : Q.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients)
        (_hflat : ∀ p : ℤ, (Q.X p).IsFlatOnSite) (n : ℕ),
        (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W n).map (ε.app Q) ≫
            (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
              ((M.quotient l E W).obj Q) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map
              ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (M.evaluation n) (.up ℤ)).hom.app Q) =
          (S.reductionEvaluation n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫
            (coefficientFiniteReductionModel l E W Q hQ n).hom
